title: Field Engineer, Life Sciences
text:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

FIELD ENGINEER, LIFE SCIENCES

We're hiring Field Engineers to partner with prospective and strategic enterprise customers across Life Sciences. You'll be the technical face of SpaceXSI for the scientific organizations shortening the path from lab to market: helping programmers, researchers, scientists, and commercial teams evaluate SpaceXSI, running proofs of concept, and making sure they see the full value of agentic coding in their real workflows. You'll work hand-in-hand with Sales, Product, and Engineering as a deal partner, not a demo resource. You'll scope solutions, demonstrate capabilities, and act as a trusted advisor across the stakeholders that matter in Life Sciences: engineering leaders, architects, developers, scientific computing, R&D, and commercial IT.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Partner with AEs to own technical discovery, demos, POCs, and expansion with technical validation; build trusted relationships across engineering, scientific computing, R&D, and commercial IT

 - Go deep in research-heavy and regulated environments: developer workflows, AI tooling, complex setups

 - Help customers connect SpaceXSI to outcomes that matter: faster R&D cycles and a shorter path from lab to market

 - Deliver technical presentations, whiteboards, and workshops for scientific and commercial audiences

 - Act as the customer's technical advocate internally with Product and Engineering; partner with post-sales to hand off cleanly and set up onboarding for success

 - Stay sharp on SpaceXSI and the competitive landscape so you can go toe to toe in the room

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

 - Experience in Field Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Pre-Sales, or Consulting for enterprise software

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - Strong communication skills and executive presence, equally comfortable coding alongside developers or presenting to CTOs and scientific leaders

 - Understand the SDLC and can connect technical detail to business and scientific impact

 - Hands-on technical fluency (not full-time eng): workflows, AI tooling, complex environments

 - Deal-partner instinct: co-own with AEs and navigate complex stakeholder maps

 - Customer-obsessed and can translate technical detail into why it matters for the organization

 - Excited by Life Sciences and comfortable learning regulated / research-heavy orgs fast

 - Motivated by putting AI in the hands of people accelerating benefits for humanity

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

 - Remote role (United States)

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

The expected annual base salary range for this role is $164,500 - $224,000. This role is also eligible for sales commissions or bonuses, with an annual on-target earnings (OTE) range of $235,000 - $320,000. OTE includes base salary plus target incentive compensation, assuming 100% achievement of applicable performance targets. Actual incentive earnings depend on performance and the terms of the applicable plan.

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer - India
text:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

FORWARD DEPLOYED ENGINEER - INDIA

You embed directly with customer teams as the engineer on the ground: own an outcome, ship a production-grade SpaceXSI system that still runs after you leave, and become the critical technical feedback loop from the field back to product engineering. The work is the project. One week you might take a messy business workflow and put a production agent on it: pick the use case, stand up the architecture, wire it into the customer's auth, data, and tools, then harden it with evals until the team actually uses it. Another week you might live in a customer's repo and delivery system and ship an agent-powered path for a migration, a PR review loop, or an incident-to-fix flow, behind tests, review, and rollout rather than in a chat sidebar.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Lead discovery with the customer: orient in their codebases and workflows, find the real bottleneck and the use case worth building, and define clear success metrics

 - Design and ship production agents, AI applications, and coding-agent workflows on Grok and our models, on live business processes and inside the customer’s engineering org

 - Get a first version live in days, then harden it over weeks with rollout, monitoring, and iteration from real usage

 - Own production quality: tracing, evals, debugging model or delivery failures, and latency and cost tradeoffs

 - Build the systems around the model (tools, MCP servers, retrieval, rules, skills, CI gates, and evals) and integrate them into the customer’s auth, data, workflow, and delivery systems; decide when prompting, architecture, data, process, or a model change is the right lever

 - Measure the outcome that matters (revenue, cost, hours saved, error rate, cycle time, escaped defects), not seat adoption

 - Work directly with Staff+, platform, and domain leaders, going deep in their systems while communicating clearly about tradeoffs and results

 - Leave the customer team able to run what you built, and turn what you learn into reusable patterns and improvements to SpaceXSI products

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

 - You have 5+ years of experience in software engineering, machine learning engineering, or data science

 - You’ve owned a customer or operator outcome, not just a slide or a prototype, and can turn a fuzzy problem into a scoped, shipped system

 - You’ve built and owned AI-native workflows or agents in production (using Python, JavaScript/TypeScript), and debugged real production failures (model, tool, data, pipeline, or delivery path)

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - 2+ years in a customer-facing role, leading discovery conversations and being accountable for outcomes for external stakeholders

 - Hands-on depth in several of: agents and tool-calling, eval harnesses, retrieval and context systems, CI/CD or developer platforms, and AI-native coding workflows in a real repo

 - Experience as a forward-deployed, solutions, or platform engineer embedded with customers, or as a founding engineer who owned an AI product end to end

title: Software Engineer
text:
Company Description

Job Description
We are seeking a Software Engineer with strong C++ and Python expertise to develop and support business-critical consumer data-processing systems. The role involves high-performance batch processing, data aggregation, calibration-support workflows, and reliable delivery of processed data to downstream platforms.
You will own features from technical design through production rollout, working across C++, Python, Oracle, and Linux-based orchestration.
Roles and Responsibilities
Design & Development
Design, develop, and maintain high-performance C++ applications and reusable Python components for enterprise data-processing pipelines.
Implement workflows for data extraction, transformation, aggregation, validation, and delivery.
Apply modern C++ practices, including RAII, smart pointers, STL containers, and clear resource ownership, to build maintainable and reliable software.
Develop and maintain Oracle-integrated processing components using SQL and existing Pro*C interfaces.
Build and enhance Bash/KornShell scripts for application execution, workflow orchestration, and operational automation.
Own technical designs, implementation, testing, documentation, and production rollout; contribute to architecture and design reviews.
Performance & Data Processing
Optimize algorithms, data structures, memory usage, database access, and file I/O for large-volume processing.
Develop and troubleshoot parallel processing workflows, addressing synchronization, resource contention, and safe concurrency.
Work with partitioned datasets and structured data formats, including CSV and Parquet, across Oracle and cloud-connected processing environments.
